_comment: Triaged signatures.  A campaign reports only signatures that are NOT in
here, so a nightly run stays quiet until something genuinely new turns up.
state=open   the bug is real and still open.  Seeing it again is expected:
it is filed under 'Known issues seen again' in REPORT.md and
does not affect the exit code.  In --regress it is an expected
reproduction, and if it STOPS reproducing the run says so, so
state=fixed  the bug was fixed.  Reproducing it again is a regression and
is reported loudly, in campaigns and in --regress alike.
Entry fields: id, signature (exact) or signature_re (regex), optional kind
and scenarios filters, state, opened, note.
